CIRCULAR

Subject: Extension of the due date for filing of the Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) for wage
month December,2025-— reg.

In view of multiple representations received from employers and other stakeholders citing
technical and operational difficulties in filing returns for the wage month of December, 2025, it has
been decided by the competent authority to extend the due date for submission of ECR for the wage

month of December, 2025 by a further period of five (05) days, i.e., up to 20.01.2026.

It is reiterated that this extension is being granted as a special measure to the employers to file

the returns. It is further clarified that no interest or damages shall be levied for ECRs and payments

made within the extended due date.

(This issues with the approval of the CPFC) \ te
